description: Defines classes and structures for HTTP response caching using uWebSockets, including CachingHttpResponse and a templated CachingApp class with cache management logic.

classes.name: CachingHttpResponse
classes.description: Handles HTTP response buffering and finalization, associated with a specific uWS::HttpResponse.

classes.name: CachingApp
classes.description: A templated web application class that implements caching logic for HTTP GET requests, derived from uWS::TemplatedAppBase.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the response buffer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes the response, sends buffered data, and records creation time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sets up a cached GET request handler with expiry logic.
